decisions.title: Secret store ladder
decisions.decision: Tier-selected SecretStore seam. personal/local default = readable per-agent env file; optional local vault; enterprise/federal = their cloud vault (AWS Secrets Manager / Azure Key Vault). Once a vault is configured it also holds agent keys and DIDs.
decisions.rationale: Josh: federal/enterprise use their own vault; personal stays simple and readable.

decisions.title: Env file location
decisions.decision: Per-agent ~/arc/team/<agent>/arc.env at 0600. The gateway Telegram token moves there in the same change; machine-level ~/.arc/arc.env is deleted, no back-compat path.
decisions.rationale: Matches per-agent workspace install (D-004); one agent cannot read another agent tokens; CON-13 forbids leaving the old path.

decisions.title: Supply chain
decisions.decision: Manifest pins exact version + sha256. arc ext add fetches once and hashes; spawn verifies hash and refuses+audits on mismatch. No fetch-at-launch (kills npx -y). tier >= enterprise additionally sandboxes the server process.
decisions.rationale: ASI04/LLM03. Fetch-at-launch is the live hole in the Hermes pattern.

decisions.title: Env safety filter
decisions.decision: Strip LD_*, DYLD_*, PYTHONSTARTUP, NODE_OPTIONS before spawning any server. AUTO-APPLIED.
decisions.rationale: Borrowed from OpenClaw; prevents a manifest hijacking the interpreter. Free.

decisions.title: Trifecta approval
decisions.decision: Per-instance approval setting in the agent toml extension block. DEFAULT: reads free, all outbound gated for human approval via cli/tui/ui. Loosenable per connected account.
decisions.rationale: Josh: default strict, operator opens it per account. Routes through the existing SPEC-035 mechanical approval path.

research.hermes: connector = optional-skill folder; SKILL.md w/ requirements+setup+tool table; setup pastes mcp_servers block into config.yaml; agentmail = agent-owned inbox
research.openclaw: two registries (plugins=npm code, mcp.servers=config); mcp add probes before save; mcp login stores OAuth creds in sqlite state db not config; toolFilter.include/exclude globs per server; env safety filter blocks LD_*/DYLD_*/PYTHONSTARTUP

atlassian: own REST adapter, seeded by existing skills
adr: ADR-030 written; ADR-018 MCP exclusion superseded
